title: No penalty for Bernardo Silva's wrestling hold on Röhl
summary: With Everton 3-2 up, Bernardo Silva grappled Merlin Röhl to the ground at a corner. Michael Oliver did not see it, and VAR Paul Howard decided the holding happened before the ball was in play. The KMI panel ruled 5-0 that it was a sustained hold that continued as the corner was taken. Jérémy Doku equalised in the 97th minute.
consequences: It was the third time in 2025-26 that VAR wrongly denied Everton a penalty.

reactions.quote: There is a clear, sustained holding offence which continues as the corner is taken and the ball comes into play.
